title: Observability: re-join a removed Loki ring member
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add observability --role loki --yes`. Finds the stopped Loki node, restarts nexus-loki, and polls /ready until it rejoins the memberlist ring.

observe.what: the stopped loki node restarts and returns /ready=200 (rejoined the ring), ~20s

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync restarts a previously-removed ring member and polls /ready for the rejoin; Prometheus/Grafana/Grafana-PG/OTel are fixed-HA -> graceful N/A.
